subject: Executive Immersion — access, AV test windows, and scheduling constraints
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@summitedge.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Executive Immersion — access, AV test windows, and scheduling constraints

Hi Ellen,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — really excited to run the executive immersion for the SummitEdge leadership team the week of July 9. To keep everything scoped, a few logistical asks so we can finalize the mutual action plan: 

- Proposed on-site days: Tue 2028-07-11 (full day) + Wed 2028-07-12 (half day). We can make the second day virtual if travel headcount changes.
- Arrival window for Redwood team: 7:30–9:00am on 7/11. Do you have onsite security check-in requirements (badges, photo ID) or an escort?
- AV test window: Mon 7/10 between 3:00–5:00pm PT. I attached a .ics for the site AV slot — can your on-prem AV contact confirm?
- Procurement note from your side: if we need a PO or SOW signed prior to presence on-site, please send the procurement contact and expected lead time.
- Dietary needs: we'll collect final headcount and meal restrictions two weeks out.

Quick call can help clear any of the above — I’m available Monday morning PT. If the dates above don’t work, share blackout windows and we’ll propose alternates.

Thanks,

Mateo Alvarez
Senior Customer Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0169

Attachment: redwood-immersion-access-checklist.pdf (1 page — access list, escort instructions, emergency contacts)
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@summitedge.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: David Liu <david.liu@summitedge.com>, summitedge-procurement@summitedge.com
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Executive Immersion — access, AV test windows, and scheduling constraints

Mateo — thanks for the clear note. High level responses below: 

- Dates: 7/11 works for the execs (they prefer in-person for the first day). 7/12 we’ll keep as tentative — we need to confirm two directors’ travel but will aim to have the half-day in person.
- Security: We require visitor badges + government-issued photo ID for non-vendor contractors. An escort from our facilities team is required until the badges are printed. I’m copying David (facilities) who will coordinate the escort.
- AV: Can your AV lead join the window on Mon 7/10 3–5pm PT — David, please confirm if that slot is open at the site.
- Procurement: We do require a PO on file for on-site labor beyond 4 people. I’ve CC’d procurement — they need a line-item SOW and invoice address.

Also — one of our execs has a tight travel limit and will only attend if we can move the first-block start time to 9:00am (instead of 8:30). Is that feasible from your side?

Thanks,

Ellen Park
Head of Customer Success | SummitEdge
ellen.park@summitedge.com | +1 (650) 555-2244
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@summitedge.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, David Liu <david.liu@summitedge.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Executive Immersion — access, AV test windows, and scheduling constraints

Ellen / team — copying our on-site ops checklist and confirming a few operational items so facilities and procurement are aligned: 

- Start time: we can shift Day 1 start to 9:00am if the program still fits (we’ll compress the morning intro and push breaks). Please confirm final attendee list by 2028-06-27 so we can lock catering.
- Escort & badges: Mateo, I’ll bring printed visitor forms for your team and coordinate with David on where to meet the guard desk. We’ll need the following for badge pre-registration:
  - Full name (as on ID)
  - Company
  - Cell phone
  - Arrival ETA

- AV test: Alex (our AV contractor) will join the 7/10 15:00–17:00 PT window. I’m attaching the site-av-window.ics and will share Alex’s mobile in a separate note to David.
- Procurement: if SummitEdge needs a PO, we can provide a one-page SOW and an invoice to the address in your PO template. Mateo — can you draft the SOW (one paragraph + dates + headcount)?

I’ll also lock a backup virtual option in case travel gets reduced — we can segment the workshop with a hybrid host setup so remote execs join only the afternoon deep-dive.

Best,

Vanessa Ortiz
Lead Onsite Operations | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183

Attachment: site-av-window.ics (calendar slot for AV test)
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@summitedge.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, David Liu <david.liu@summitedge.com>, summitedge-procurement@summitedge.com
Date: Sat, 2 Jun 2028 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Executive Immersion — access, AV test windows, and scheduling constraints

Thanks — all helpful. Summary (agree / action owners):

1) Dates & times: Day 1 in-person Tue 7/11 start 9:00am (agreed) — Day 2 tentative Wed 7/12 (half day) pending final RSVP. (Mateo — send final RSVP deadline 2028-06-27.)
2) Badges & escort: David to confirm entry point and escort; Vanessa to bring printed visitor forms for pre-registration. (David: please reply with meet point and guard desk hours.)
3) AV: Alex (redwood contractor) booked for Mon 7/10 15:00–17:00 PT. Vanessa to share Alex mobile to David. (Vanessa: please confirm once done.)
4) Procurement: Mateo to draft one-page SOW + line items and send to summitedge-procurement@summitedge.com by 2028-06-05. Procurement to advise on PO lead time.
5) Catering & headcount: final attendee list and dietary restrictions due 2028-06-27.

Next steps: I’ll upload the one-page SOW draft to the shared Drive folder and post the link to the Jira ticket ENGINF-2187. If there are any blockers on PO timing that prevent on-site presence, we’ll switch Day 1 to a hybrid model and ship a small hardware kit in advance so execs can interact with a live demo without full on-site labor.

Thanks, looking forward to firming this up.

— Mateo
Senior Customer Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0169
